stories.title: Follow live: Seahawks look to bounce back, visit Broncos
Halpin home run helps Guardians take 2-1 ALCS lead over Rays
stories.summary: Petey Halpin hit a go-ahead, two-run homer as the Guardians beat the Rays 3-2 in Game 3 on Thursday to take a 2-1 lead in the ALCS.

stories.title: Eagles QB Hurts ruled out vs. Panthers with blood clot in calf
stories.summary: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers due to a superficial blood clot in his calf.

stories.title: Dodgers return Ohtani to leadoff spot for must-win Game 4
stories.summary: With the Dodgers trailing 3-0 in their best-of-seven series, manager Dave Roberts has returned Shohei Ohtani to the top of the lineup for Game 4 vs. the Brewers.

stories.title: Daniels addresses teammates on OT gaffe, vows 'it'll never happen again'
stories.summary: Jayden Daniels addressed his Commanders teammates, once more blaming himself for the end-of-overtime debacle against the Giants and vowing it won't happen again.
